# Univariate Gaussian Response

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-align: "center"


## Simulate the data
set.seed(12345)                              # Set seed for reproducibility
m = 1                                        # Nº of covariates
n = 500                                      # Nº of instances
x <- runif(n, 0, 1)                          # Sampled covariate
X = as.matrix(x)                             
f = 0.4 * (x + 2*exp(-1*(16*(x-0.5))^2))     # True effect 
f = f - mean(f)
FF = as.matrix(f)
y = f + rnorm(n, 0, 0.05)                    # Response


## AKSSAM 
model = AKSSAM(X = X, y = y, family = "gaussian", 
               lambda.init = rep(10, m), ndx = rep(60, m), bdeg = rep(3, m), 
               maxiter1 = 100, maxiter2 = 100, maxiter3 = 100, 
               tol1 = 1e-5, tol2 = 1e-5, tol3 = 1e-5, 
               epsilon = 1e-5)


## Obtain the estimated sets of knots and coefficients
K_sel = model$K_sel                   # Selected knots
Design_list = model$New_Design_list   # Design matrices
alpha = model$alpha.new               # Coefficients
B_star <- do.call(cbind, Design_list) # Joint design matrix B*
predictions <- B_star %*% alpha       # Predictions in X

## Make predictions and independent effects in any 
# Initialize terms
Design_list = vector("list", m + 1)
Design_list[[1]] = matrix(1, 100, 1) 
basis_length = rep(0,m)
covariate_predictions = vector("list", m)
bdeg = rep(3, m)
# Iterate through covariates
for (t in 1:m){
  # Build the design matrix with selected knots
  B = my.bbase4(seq(0,1, length.out = 100), K_sel[[t]], bdeg[t])
  Design_list[[t+1]] = B
  basis_length[t] = dim(B)[2]
  if (t == 1){index_0 = 2; index_1 = 1 + basis_length[1]
  }else{index_0 = 2 + sum(basis_length[1:(t-1)]); index_1 = index_0 + basis_length[t] - 1}
  # Effect of the t-th covariate
  covariate_predictions[[t]] = B %*% alpha[index_0:index_1]
}
# Entire prediction
B_star <- do.call(cbind, Design_list) # Joint design matrix B*
predictions <- B_star %*% alpha     


## Plot the results
plot_list <- lapply(1:m, function(i) {
    
    # Order the X values
    o <- order(X[, i])
    
    # True effect
    data <- data.frame( 
        x = X[o, i], 
        y = y[o],
        type = "True Effect"
    )
    
    # Estimated effect
    predicts <- data.frame( 
        x = seq(0, 1, length.out = 100),
        pred = covariate_predictions[[i]],
        type = "Estimated Effect"
    )
    
    # Knot positions
    knots <- data.frame(
        x = K_sel[[i]],
        y = 0,
        type = "Selected Knots"
    )
    
    # Plot the data
    plot <- ggplot() +
        # Observed points
        geom_point(data = data, aes(x, y, color = type), 
                   shape = 1, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +  
        # Estimated line
        geom_line(data = predicts, aes(x, pred, color = type), 
                  linewidth = 1.2) +         
        # Knots
        geom_point(data = knots, aes(x, y, color = type), 
                   shape = 16, size = 3) +
        # Custom colors
        scale_color_manual(
            values = c("True Effect" = "grey40", 
                       "Estimated Effect" = "#E41A1C", 
                       "Selected Knots" = "#377EB8")
        ) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
        theme(
            axis.title = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
            panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.5),
            plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
            axis.text = element_text(color = "grey40"),
            legend.position = "none"
        ) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed")
    
    return(plot)
})

# Combine the plots
combined <- wrap_plots(plot_list, nrow = 1, guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
        title = "Gaussian Example",
        theme = theme(
            plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                                     color = "#2C3E50"),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, 
                                        color = "#5D6D7E", margin = margin(b = 10))
        )
    ) &
    theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "#2C3E50"),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.9), 
                                         color = "grey80", 
                                         linewidth = 0.5,
                                         linetype = "solid"),
        legend.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 15, b = 8, l = 15),
        legend.spacing.x = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm"),
        legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")
    )

# Display the plot
print(combined)
```


# Multivariate Binomial Response

```{r}
# Function for data simulation
simulate.data.binom = function(m, n){

  set.seed(12345)                      # Set seed for reproducibility
  
  X = matrix(1, n, m)                  # Initialize the instance mat.
  FF = matrix(1, n, m)                 # Initialize the func. values mat.
  f_total = rep(0, n)                  # Linear estimator
  
  for (i in 1:m) {
    x <- runif(n, 0, 1)
    X[, i] <- scale(x, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
    
    if (i == 1) {
      f <- sin(5.5 * pi * x) + 3 * x - 5 * x^2 + cos(10 * pi * x)
    } else {
      f <- 2.5* sin(pi^2 * x)
    }
    
    f_centered <- f - mean(f)
    FF[, i] <- f_centered
    f_total <- f_total + f_centered
  }
  
  
  p <- plogis(f_total)                 # Binomial probabilities
  y <- rbinom(n, 1, p)                 # Response

  
  list(X = X,
       y = y,
       FF = FF)
}
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 5
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-align: "center"

## Simulate the data
m = 2                           # Nº of covariates
n = 1000                        # Nº of instances
ll = simulate.data.binom(m,n)   # Simulate the data
X = ll$X                        # Covariate samples
y = ll$y                        # Objective variable
FF = ll$FF                      # Real additive terms values 
rm(ll)                          # Erase the list


## AKSSAM 
model = AKSSAM(X = X, y = y, family = "binomial", 
               lambda.init = rep(10, m), ndx = rep(30, m), bdeg = rep(3L, m), 
               maxiter1 = 100, maxiter2 = 100, maxiter3 = 100, 
               tol1 = 1e-5, tol2 = 1e-5, tol3 = 1e-5, 
               epsilon = 1e-5)

## Obtain the estimated sets of knots and coefficients
K_sel = model$K_sel                   # Selected knots
Design_list = model$New_Design_list   # Design matrices
alpha = model$alpha.new               # Coefficients
B_star <- do.call(cbind, Design_list) # Joint design matrix B*
predictions <- B_star %*% alpha       # Predictions in X

## Make predictions and independent effects in any 
# Initialize terms
Design_list = vector("list", m + 1)
Design_list[[1]] = matrix(1, 100, 1) 
basis_length = rep(0,m)
covariate_predictions = vector("list", m)
bdeg = rep(3, m)
# Iterate through covariates
for (t in 1:m){
  # Build the design matrix with selected knots
  B = my.bbase4(seq(-0.5,0.5, length.out = 100), K_sel[[t]], bdeg[t])
  Design_list[[t+1]] = B
  basis_length[t] = dim(B)[2]
  if (t == 1){index_0 = 2; index_1 = 1 + basis_length[1]
  }else{index_0 = 2 + sum(basis_length[1:(t-1)]); index_1 = index_0 + basis_length[t] - 1}
  # Effect of the t-th covariate
  covariate_predictions[[t]] = B %*% alpha[index_0:index_1]
}
# Entire prediction
B_star <- do.call(cbind, Design_list) # Joint design matrix B*
predictions <- B_star %*% alpha     


## Plot the results
plot_list <- lapply(1:m, function(i) {
    
    # Order the X values
    o <- order(X[, i])
    
    # True effect
    data <- data.frame( 
        x = X[o, i], 
        y = FF[o,i],
        type = "True Effect"
    )
    
    # Estimated effect
    predicts <- data.frame( 
        x = seq(-0.5,0.5, length.out = 100),
        pred = covariate_predictions[[i]],
        type = "Estimated Effect"
    )
    
    # Knot positions
    knots <- data.frame(
        x = K_sel[[i]],
        y = 0,
        type = "Selected Knots"
    )
    
    # Plot the data
    plot <- ggplot() +
        # Observed points
        geom_point(data = data, aes(x, y, color = type), 
                   shape = 1, size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +  
        # Estimated line
        geom_line(data = predicts, aes(x, pred, color = type), 
                  linewidth = 1.2) +         
        # Knots
        geom_point(data = knots, aes(x, y, color = type), 
                   shape = 16, size = 3) +
        # Custom colors
        scale_color_manual(
            values = c("True Effect" = "grey40", 
                       "Estimated Effect" = "#E41A1C", 
                       "Selected Knots" = "#377EB8")
        ) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
        theme(
            axis.title = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
            panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.5),
            plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
            axis.text = element_text(color = "grey40"),
            legend.position = "none"  
        ) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed")
    
    return(plot)
})

# Combine the plots 
combined <- wrap_plots(plot_list, nrow = 1, guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
        title = "Binomial Example",
        theme = theme(
            plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                                     color = "#2C3E50"),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, 
                                        color = "#5D6D7E", margin = margin(b = 10))
        )
    ) &
    theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "#2C3E50"),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.9), 
                                         color = "grey80", 
                                         linewidth = 0.5,
                                         linetype = "solid"),
        legend.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 15, b = 8, l = 15),
        legend.spacing.x = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm"),
        legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")
    )

# Display the plot
print(combined)
```
